findings.description: Direct crouch and sit views show the rear overskirt kicked behind the hips and the opaque shorts exposed across most of the thighs. Coverage is maintained by the shorts, but the intended skirt silhouette and coverage balance collapse in these poses.

The five neutral views retain broad, coarse angular surface facets across the overskirt and upper jacket. Pleats read as irregular crumpling rather than regular sewn folds; v18 softening did not resolve this.
The back view still does not clearly reveal the rear adjustment tab or buckle; they remain low-contrast and nearly flush with the skirt/waist seam.
Lavender hem piping is now visible, but jacket seam trim and elbow quilting remain faint. The predominantly plain ivory surface still misses the fencing-set detail level.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V18 directly reviewed after fresh five-view and six-pose render: under-shorts extended to 60 mm, skirt pleats softened, lavender edge piping enabled, and rear tab enlarged/raised. Neutral hem concealment is improved, but sit/crouch roll the overskirt behind the hips leaving shorts conspicuous; folds remain coarse and irregular; back tab and jacket/elbow details remain faint. UV remains NOT_CREATED.

nextAction: REJECT. Keep v18 as an unapproved prototype. Revise the overskirt/shorts construction to preserve a visible skirt drape during sit and crouch while retaining opaque shorts coverage; reduce surface faceting, create regular sewn pleats, give the rear tab a clear attached silhouette and buckle, and strengthen jacket seam/elbow detailing. Then build once and directly review all five views and six poses. UV, fit, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
